env AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=creds.file
env AWS_PROFILE=profile

mito -use aws,collections,http,time src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
[
	request("GET", "http://www.example.com/"),
	request("GET", "http://www.example.com/", "request data"),
	get_request("http://www.example.com/"),
	post_request("http://www.example.com/", "text/plain", "request data"),
].map(req,
	req.sign_aws_from_shared(
		"", "",
		{
			"service" :"service",
			"region" :"region",
			"sign_time" :timestamp("2009-11-10T23:00:00Z"),
			"no_hoist" :false,
			"no_escape" :false,
			"disable_session_token" :false,
		}
	)
)
-- creds.file --
[profile]
aws_access_key_id = id
aws_secret_access_key = key
